business_summary: App-based provider of renters and pet insurance starting at $5 a month, targeting new renters and recent pet adopters.
stated_claims: Renters and pet insurance starting at about $5 a month
fulfillment_notes: Insurance services delivered digitally via mobile application.

relevant_tags.why: Core category for pet insurance offering.
Renters insurance is directly related to home and living spaces.
App-based management appeals to convenience-oriented consumers.
Insurance is billed on a monthly recurring subscription model.
Shoppers buying pet supplies are pet owners who may need pet insurance.
Shoppers buying pet food are pet owners who may need pet insurance.
Shoppers buying pet medications are highly likely to value pet health insurance.

note_signals.why: Health-conscious pet owners are highly aligned with pet health insurance.
Largest pet audience in the catalog provides excellent scale for pet insurance.
Millennials treating dogs as family are highly likely to invest in pet insurance.
Urban/suburban home buyers and renters are prime targets for renters insurance.
New-home life events are key triggers for purchasing renters insurance.

gate_reason: The product, pricing model, and target audiences (renters and pet owners) are clearly defined and map well to our publisher network.
clarifying_questions: Are your insurance products available nationwide, or only in specific US states?
Do you offer a bundle discount if a user purchases both renters and pet insurance?
Is there a specific age demographic (e.g., Gen Z/Millennial) you want to prioritize for the app-based delivery?
